_doc: Material ramps for fxkit, dark -> bright. Roles by index: 0 ink, 1 dark, 2 body, 3 highlight, 4 core (the 1-2 frame hot moment). Every colour must be in art_src/palette/tessera_master.gpl (checked on load); none may be near the telegraph red #E5293B. Hero block colours follow art bible §4 'Khối của năm anh hùng'.
